projectDescription: Mydva (AyurGuide) is a personalized Ayurvedic health platform that combines AI-powered Dosha analysis, 3D herbal and chakra exploration, Groq LLM consultations, and live WebRTC video sessions with certified Ayurvedic practitioners.
keyFeatures: Dosha Analysis Quiz – Multi-dimensional questionnaire computing precise Vata/Pitta/Kapha percentage breakdowns
AI-Powered Personal Consultation – Groq Llama 3.3-70B generates tailored dietary plans, herbal suggestions, and lifestyle routines
3D Herbal Remedies Explorer – Interactive Three.js renders of medicinal plants (Ashwagandha, Turmeric, Tulsi, Brahmi, Triphala, Shatavari)
Interactive 3D Chakra System – All 7 chakras with sacred geometry, mantra players, mudra visualizers, and breathing guides
Expert Talk – Schedule and conduct live video consultations with certified Ayurvedic doctors via WebRTC
Wellness Center Directory – Geo-based discovery of Ayurvedic clinics and Panchakarma centers
Ayurveda Education Hub – Structured articles, videos, and wellness guides
JWT Authentication – Secure user accounts with HTTP-only cookie sessions
